fetch.method=http sources are downloaded and checked against sha256 by scripts/dataset_v2/pipeline.py fetch. A hash mismatch fails the build; the publisher may have revised the file and the change must be reviewed.
fetch.method=manual sources could not be downloaded automatically (login wall or HTML-only). Their values stay at needs_manual_review until a reviewer records the primary document hash.
license.status=unverified means the reuse terms were not confirmed. Facts (numbers) may be cited. Do NOT put the source's text into the RAG corpus until the terms are confirmed.
